name: Dabeiba (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, green and black, the white twice the height of the others, overlaid by a yellow diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Dabeiba, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
